Name: Sales Order Form
Field1Value: Created by the Sales Rep for dealer and retail client orders. Includes the delivery or pickup date. Used by the Delivery Head to schedule routes. Signed by the client if pickup with terms.
Field2Value: Sales Rep creates Sales Order Form · Specifies delivery/pickup date · Delivery Head reads to schedule route · Client signs for pickup with terms

Name: Invoice
Field1Value: Billing document issued to clients. Collected by Accounting together with the DR and Sales Order as a package for receivables reconciliation. Linked to the Accounts Receivable subprocess.
Field2Value: Issued on delivery · Accounting collects DR + Sales Order + Invoice · Used for monthly receivables summary and bank reconciliation

Name: Credit Notes (CR)
Field1Value: Document issued to the client recording the cylinder weight residue credits. Contains the cylinder serial number and weight residue. Warehouse generates 2 DRs and 2 CRs per delivery. Threshold: 1–3 kg residue triggers roundup/rounddown classification.
Field2Value: Pahinante records weight · Driver provides Credit Notes to client with cylinder serial # and weight residue · Submitted to Accounting

Name: Promissory Note
Field1Value: Required fallback payment-security document for a dealer who cannot issue Post-Dated Checks. Executed before installment credit is extended in place of PDCs.
Field2Value: Used when dealer cannot provide PDCs · Executed before installment terms are granted · Filed alongside the dealer's AR record

Name: Post-Dated Checks (PDC)
Field1Value: Default payment security collected from dealers on installment terms (about 70% of dealers). A Promissory Note is the required fallback when a dealer cannot issue PDCs.
Field2Value: Collected for installment orders · Tracked in Google Sheets by due date · Missing PDC triggers Promissory Note requirement

Name: Entry/Exit Slip (EES)
Field1Value: Gate document issued to a dealer or retail vehicle on plant entry, recording cylinder quantities and tank classification. Validated by the Guard on both entry and final exit.
Field2Value: Guard issues on vehicle entry · Guard validates tank classification · Guard performs final exit verification before release

Name: Loading/Unloading Ticket (LUT)
Field1Value: Cover cylinder sizes 2.7 kg, 11 kg, and 50 kg. Used to balance empty and field cylinder data when preparing the Incentive template for payroll.
Field2Value: Accounting uses LUT forms (check 2.7kg, 11kg, 50kg) to balance empty and field cylinders · Feeds into Incentive template · Used for Commercial and Retail payroll

Name: Picklist
Field1Value: Warehouse picking document generated per order. Lists the specific cylinders (type, size, quantity) to be picked from storage for a delivery. Generated before the Delivery Receipt.
Field2Value: Warehouse generates Picklist after order confirmation · Staff picks cylinders per Picklist · Feeds into DR generation

Name: Delivery Receipt (DR)
Field1Value: The primary delivery document that accompanies each cylinder delivery. The Driver carries the DR for multiple clients. The client signs the DR on receipt. The signed DR is submitted to Accounting for General Ledger reconciliation.
Field2Value: Warehouse generates 2 DRs and 2 CRs per delivery · Driver carries DR to client · Client signs · Driver submits signed DR to Acctg · Acctg reconciles GL with signed DR and AR

Name: General Ledger (GL)
Field1Value: The central accounting ledger entry updated for each delivery and financial transaction. Acctg Staff reconciles the General Ledger with the signed DR and AR after each delivery cycle. Usage
Field2Label: Warehouse submits DR to Accounting to make General Ledger and Inventory entry · Acctg Staff reconciles GL with signed DR and AR

Name: Receiving Report (RR)
Field1Value: Document filled by the Plant Manager when a Lorry Truck delivery arrives from the Refinery Supplier. Records the volume unloaded to the Storage Tank. Any changes in quantity after the RR are reported separately.
Field2Value: Plant Manager fills RR on truck arrival · Documents volume unloaded · Post-RR changes reported separately · Feeds into inventory records

Name: Purchase Order (PO)
Field1Value: Procurement document forwarded by the Purchaser to the Refinery Supplier to order gas stock. Triggers the inbound delivery process at the plant, which generates the Receiving Report.
Field2Value: Purchaser forwards PO to Refinery Supplier · Supplier schedules Lorry Truck delivery · Plant Manager receives and logs in RR

Name: RFR-Appsheet
Field1Value: Appsheet for refilling cylinders.
Field2Value: Checker encodes transaction in RFR-AppSheet. OIC-Accounting verifies RFR-AppSheet vs. Invoice before release

Name: Sales-Appsheet
Field1Value: Encode and Check Sales of Commercial, Bulk, Dealers. This will extract the real-time approval matrix process currently done in ACCPAC.
Field2Value: T1 - Summary table for ACCPAC encoding/checking,T2 - Inventory Month-end Report,T3 - Overall Sales Summary,T4 - Basic Sales Summary ,T5 - Sales Entry Form.

Name: PO-Appsheet
Field1Value: Appsheet for encoding and summarizing Purchase Orders. This will extract the real-time approval matrix process currently done in ACCPAC.

Name: DPI-Appsheet
Field1Value: Appsheet for encoding and summarizing daily physical inventory (DPI). This will extract the real-time approval matrix process currently done in ACCPAC.

Name: General Refilling Report (GRR)
Field1Value: xx

Name: Sales Performance Report (SPR)
Field1Value: Bi-weekly or monthly sales report printed by IT Head depending on inventory volume. Fields: sales per kg, total sales, net sales, cost of sales (with formula), Gross Profit Margin per kg and total GPM.
Field2Value: IT Head prints SPR · Shared with management · Informs Pricing Matrix decisions

Name: Incentive Template
Field1Value: Template used for bi-monthly (15th and 30th) payroll incentive computation for Commercial and Retail channels. Populated using LUT forms and cylinder balance data.
Field2Value: Prepare Incentive template for Commercial and Retail · Use LUT forms to balance cylinder data · Encode in payroll on 15th and 30th

Name: Aged Receivables
Field1Value: Summary report of outstanding client receivables organized by age and duration. Printed monthly as part of the Accounts Receivable subprocess to identify overdue accounts.
Field2Value: Print summary of Aged Receivables monthly · Review overdue accounts · Escalate for dispute resolution or write-off

Name: LPG Pricing Matrix
Field1Value: Dashboard document for deciding gas prices across all sales avenues. Reviewed 1–3 times per month in a General Meeting. Covers Sales Price, MPL, Total Cost (Acq Cost + Hauling), kg per avenue, and volume discounts for different radii.
Field2Value: Commercial to Retail and semi-dealers · MPL volume discounts by radius · End-user SRP vs. competitors

Name: Payroll Summary
Field1Value: Monthly payroll summary document for all staff. Consolidates all incentive computations and salary data. Used as the official payroll record for the period.
Field2Value: Prepared after Incentive template is finalized · Covers all staff · Released on the 15th and 30th of each month

Name: Budget PNL
Field1Value: Budgeted Profit and Loss report for industrial projects. Sets the expected financial targets against which the Actual PNL is compared during project review.
Field2Value: Prepared at project start · Compared against Actual PNL during review · Part of Industrial Projects tracking subprocess

Name: Actual PNL
Field1Value: Actual Profit and Loss performance report for industrial projects. Compared against the Budget PNL to measure project financial performance.
Field2Value: Updated as project progresses · Compared with Budget PNL · Part of Industrial Projects tracking subprocess
